map.title: The Front Window
map.blurb: Our little stage on Dunn Road. Whatever is catching the afternoon light this week is usually the first thing to go.

map.title: Glassware & Kitchen
map.blurb: Vintage glassware, pressed-glass goblets, mixing bowls and the odd treasured casserole dish, sorted by hand one cup at a time.

map.title: Linens & Textiles
map.blurb: Textured linens, quilts, tablecloths and throws, folded and stacked for an unhurried browse.

map.title: Furniture & Décor
map.blurb: Heirloom wooden pieces, chairs with stories in their joints, lamps and eclectic home accents.

map.title: Donation Drop-off
map.blurb: Bring pre-loved pieces to the back during regular open hours. Every donation gets a dignified second act, and helps us give to St. Jude.

map.title: Books & Records
map.blurb: Rare books, well-loved paperbacks and a crate of vinyl worth flipping through twice.

map.title: Clothing & Denim
map.blurb: Racks of vintage denim, everyday essentials and one-of-a-kind finds, restocked constantly.

map.title: Checkout & Coffee
map.blurb: Pay with cash, card, Cash App or Venmo, and say hello. This is where found treasures wait for their new homes.
